note.signedInTicking: You are signed in as {email}. This step is being ticked for you.

deposit.title: Your deposit
deposit.short: You are {amount} short of the deposit.

costs.title: Your extra costs on {price}
costs.total: Total, on top of the deposit
costs.newHouse: The calculator is set to a new house, so stamp duty is worked out on the price without 13.5% VAT.
costs.newApartment: The calculator is set to a new apartment, so stamp duty is worked out on the price without 9% VAT.

htb.title: Help to Buy and you
htb.mover: Your calculator says you are moving home. Help to Buy is for first-time buyers only, so you can skip this optional step.
htb.secondHand: Your calculator is set to a second-hand home. Help to Buy only covers new builds and self-builds, so choose New house or New apartment in the calculator if that is what you are looking at.
htb.overCap: Your target price of {price} is above the {cap} limit, so Help to Buy would not apply.
htb.loanTooSmall: Help to Buy needs a mortgage of at least 70% of the price, which is {minLoan} at your target price. You can borrow up to {maxLoan}, so Help to Buy would not apply at this price.
htb.borrowEnough: It also needs a mortgage of at least 70% of the price ({minLoan}), so plan to borrow that much and keep the rest of your savings.
htb.note: The final amount is also limited by the income tax and DIRT you paid in the last four years. Your Revenue application shows it.

mine.notSaved: Your figures are not saved in this browser yet. Open the calculator and choose Save to my journey to see them here.
